title: International Structured Lease Associate/VP
full_description:
Product Relationship Management
International Structured Lease Associate/VPLease Belgium

Your role & work environment
ING is a market leader in the Belgian financial leasing market and offers clients a complete service for the leasing of assets for professional use: sales, back office and after care. Leasing is serviced through ING Lease Belgium,a subsidiary of ING Bank Belgium locally and Global Leasing internationally.
As an International Structured Lease Expert, you are the ambassador on behalf of ING Lease Belgium, for both our Wholesale Banking customers and ING Bank Belgium. You create visibility in the market and in the distribution channel of Wholesale Banking within ING. At Lease, we have arranged numerous leasing facilities and are involved in all lease-related matters of the client relationship. You contribute to the planned growth in production and profitability, while respecting the strategy and guidelines of Lease. You report to the Sales Manager of Lease and are part of the Sales team Equipment lease.
Your key responsibilities
You visit customers, with or without other lease colleagues or relationship managers, in the framework of the lease relationship, gathering relevant information and originating newtransactions.
